title: From Black Boxes to Transparent Minds: Evaluating and Enhancing the Theory of Mind in Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the 'Theory of Mind' (the cognitive ability to attribute mental states to others) in multimodal large language models using a spatial 2D grid world dataset (GridToM). While it deals with beliefs and cognitive perspective-taking, it does not benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral value systems.
